Mydei hated this.

There was one person he had always avoided at all costs, solely because he smelled so delicious that Mydei feared for his own sanity - and that pissed him off endlessly. 

Phainon.

The man he wanted and craved so badly, the man whose scent drove him into an early rut sometimes and made his life a living hell every single time. And now he was trapped with just Phainon on this mission, trapped with the person that made him want to let that man have his way with him.

.. There was just one major issue with that.

Phainon is an omega, and Mydei is.. Not that.

Mydei hated his secondary gender, truthfully, mostly because of how praised he was over it when he didn’t feel as if it had fit him at all. So very upsetting when everyone looked at him as some type of demon in bed, the type of man to dominate you and leave you limping. When Mydei was the one that wanted to be on the receiving end of that.

He wanted to be trapped beneath the man he currently was sitting on top of a dromas with, eyes gazing hollowly at the forest lost in his own thoughts. Mainly because if he actually focused on the man that was almost shoulder to shoulder with him - he feared for his sanity.

Only, he sadly wasn’t the only one who had a say in that currently; “Mydeimos? Are you listening to me?”

Mydei snapped his eyes back to Phainon - barely even aware the omega had been speaking before, and he truly hadn’t meant any disrespect by looking away. If anything, he worried he would look at Phainon rather disrespectfully as he felt that hunger churn in his stomach uncomfortably. 

That deep rooted lust he felt for this man that knew no equal, which was fine - perfect for the man he deemed his rival and actual equal anyway. Yet it was unbearable to try to hide constantly, to act like it all was fine when he wanted nothing more than to spar with Phainon. To lose and feel Phainon’s weight settling on top of him while the omega bragged over it.

Teasing him about being an alpha beneath an omega.. But every time Phainon said such silly phrases, they only burned Mydei’s ears even more over how much he did want that. Over how much he wanted Phainon to push his head into the bed and use him however he pleased - even if it was uncharacteristic of the deliverer he knew. 

“Yes, Deliverer.” Mydei managed to say as his eyes trailed that man’s wispy white hair - watching the way it swayed in the wind every time their mount took another step. Ruffled hair bouncing cutely, icy blue eyes as sharp as ever as he stared at Mydei.

But that seemed to have been enough as Phainon moved to sit across from Mydei, crossing his legs to go through his bags he had packed idly; “Right.. As I was saying, we’ll make a stop in the town by the border of Okhema, the black tide hasn’t reached it yet so it’s rather peaceful there. I’ll need to make some negotiations with the dealer Aglaea set up..”

Phainon hummed over his thoughts, all before pulling out his teleslate to allegedly look at a map - which Mydei had to squint over. Surely this farmboy knew exactly where they were going?

“It’s a peaceful city by the beach, but you’re not overly fond of the sea, are you?” Phainon innocently asked as he looked away from his phone - bright blue eyes piercing into Mydei easily as soon as he focused on him.

And Mydei found himself only able to sigh over that, “.. Not particularly, no.”

Phainon hummed in response as he put his phone away again, only to immediately drag something out of his bags - something that he then threw to Mydei gently.

“I picked these up for you before we left, by the way!” Phainon told Mydei, and Mydei’s own instincts moved to grab the thing thrown to him out of the hair with his gauntlets - a level of skill displayed to not crush the tender flesh of it between his heavy fists.

All before blinking and staring at it, turning it in his hands confusedly, “Pomegranates?”

Phainon nodded, making Mydei flick his eyes up to stare at that smiling man - staring at the way he could see those scent blockers beneath his shirt; “Your favorite!”

Those blockers irked Mydei, not because he was angry Phainon used them, but because he felt almost jealous in a way. Jealous that he couldn’t smell Phainon as deeply as he desperately wanted, and jealous of that choker that was always around his neck. Probably to help him with unwanted bites as a Heir, but Mydei.. 

Wanted it on his own neck, instead.

“Thank you.” Was all Mydei’s brain managed to reply with instead, jerking his eyes back to the red skin of that fruit in his hand idly. 

“Mhm..” Phainon didn’t look away - only remaining staring at Mydei as if he were trying to gauge his reaction even deeper, all before sighing and tearing his eyes away to look at the tree line, “Anyway, I’ll handle the meeting if you handle finding us lodging when we get to town?”

Mydei had to look at Phainon over that, staring at him to meticulously study whatever the hell the omega had meant by those words for just a few moments before shaking his own head; “I refuse.”

“Huh?” Phainon asked, looking back at Mydei with such a bewildered expression - which was natural. They usually separated and conquered their enemies faster that way, yet this wasn’t as simple as dividing and conquering for speed, this was a simple trade negotiation for .. Whatever Aglaea had seemed keen for. 

Mydei hadn’t been privy to that information, but it’s not like he cared - a task was a task, and he would see it through either way.

“I assume we’ve been put on this mission together for a reason, I’ll attend the negotiations.” Mydei practically sighed out, moving to cross his arms over his chest as he stared at that omega who looked.. Significantly more uncomfortable with those words. 

“But Mydei-”

“What, Deliverer? You think I haven’t seen any shady underhanded deals in my lifetime?” Mydei interrupted as he stared into Phainon’s eyes with a narrowed stare - studying the way he seemed to swallow heavily over those words.

As if he were truly floundering here to figure out what to say exactly to Mydei.

“Haha, fair enough! But I..” Phainon uncharacteristically trailed off, looking more and more nervous and that.. That only made Mydei raise a brow so very slowly. Watching the ticks in Phainon’s jaw, the twitches in his hand, and tightness in his posture.. Odd.

“What is it? Spit it out.” Mydei pressed forward, raising a brow over the way Phainon seemed to be trying to avoid saying something.

Was it truly about the details about the mission? Mydei doubted it was anything worth the stress, considering they usually fought titankin easily together.. 

Phainon laughed gently over that yet again; “I merely worry you may be out of your depth!”

“Out of my depth..?” Mydei echoed, raising a brow curiously over what on Amphoreus that could possibly mean - but he could only imagine Phainon was making up some excuses. 

“It’s about making the best deals here, so-”

“You are the one who blows all of their balance coins on antiques that rarely are real.” Mydei pointed out curtly, feeling himself huff slightly over those words. Over how he was slowly doubting it was about getting a good deal in general. 

“Okay.. Well.. Sometimes I buy the real ones!” Phainon rivaled that, as if that made it any better when he still bought the wrong things sometimes - only partly being right didn’t erase the other mishaps.. 

Mydei could only roll his eyes over that; “On accident.”

“No! No.. It’s on purpose! I do my best, you know?” Phainon huffed out, and that made Mydei look at him egregiously - mainly because he didn’t think it was always Phainon’s best. He was rather sure he was light-heartedly joking and making light of his hobby to avoid being judged too much for it. Even if he was actually rather good at it - it was almost like Phainon preferred a small wall between him and people he didn’t know.

Maybe even people he did know, considering Mydei couldn’t say he had any idea what Phainon’s favorite color was, let alone favorite food and the likes.. 

… He didn’t think he had a good reason to ask, either. All he ever did was make Phainon meals and try to gauge if he really liked them, or was lying about it to help Mydei save face. Even though the latter was useless considering the fact Mydei was quite aware he is a decent chef.

Regardless, he huffed over that reply; “I think I would have better luck merely guessing.”

“Cruel..” Phainon whimpered out instantly, clearly not very bothered by it.

Probably because both of them were joking, anyway.

“But you are not denying it.” Mydei pointed out yet again, raising a brow as he leaned back slightly - only to look at the fruit still in his hand idly. A gift from an omega.. That was normally seen as a courting gesture, but Mydei was quite sure this was nothing of the sort.

After all, he didn’t think he was the type of person Phainon would want to mate with, anyway. How could he be when he had seen the way that omega looked at other alphas, practically purring over their closeness and smiling fondly at them. All before cutting a small stare to Mydei - always knowing he was watching.

Why?

He was always so odd, but Mydei could do nothing but turn away every time. Tell himself it didn’t involve him and that Phainon could go after whoever he thought of fondly and admired.

And that just so happened to be anyone but Mydei.

That was fine, Mydei had never exactly been very loved in this life from start to finish. 

“Well.. I do think I would do better than you guessing..” Phainon hummed out, all while looking so painfully smug over the situation, “But I have to let you have your fun sometimes, don’t I?”

Phainon asked with a rather obvious wink, one that Mydei had to look away from - feeling his face burn over that handsome omega aiming such a gesture at him.

“Hmph.” Was all Mydei replied with as he looked away - full on scowling now as he sat there. 

It was always like that.

Phainon would do things like that.. Gestures towards people, flirting and smiling - the smallest of things that Mydei.. Didn’t quite understand. Or maybe he did understand. 

The charm of the omega couldn’t be understated, a wink and dazzling smile were enough to make anyone fold, really.  

That made even more sense when he saw Phainon flirting with alphas in front of Mydei so much - seeming so keen on letting Mydei know that he was searching for his mate in this life. Always letting Mydei know and watch as it was never him, never the one for his affections and that it was one sided. 

Those dashing and charming smiles were always for other alphas - even if Phainon always was checking to make sure Mydei was watching with those vivid blue eyes wandering to him.

“You seem rather distant today, Mydei. Are you alright?” Phainon asked, and that made Mydei turn his head to look at him - always deserving of respect and eye contact while they talked. Even if Mydei desperately wanted to look anywhere but at the man he was lustful towards. 

If anything, he wanted to bury his head in sand to try to escape that sweet distant scent he could smell on the wind - a weak thing considering Phainon’s scent blockers and most likely medication he was taking. But beneath it all, it was so painfully.. Phainon.

Sweet vanilla, faint and delicious to Mydei’s nose with just the slightest bit of an odd earthy smell - one that didn’t quite fit an omega usually, but for the farmer boy whose home was of the wheatfields, it made sense to Mydei’s brain. 

Mydei had to blink over it, doing his best not to visibly wrinkle his nose as he sniffed at the air idly, “I’m fine.”

“Is that so? What’s on your mind then?” Phainon pressed, clearly not buying the fact that Mydei was ‘fine’ and was nosy to hell and back. Mydei found himself sighing over it - over how he didn’t dare discuss how he wanted those smiles to be for him.

That he wanted this omega to look at him like he was someone Phainon would consider. But that was impossible anyway, Mydei knew that.

… Since, after all, most importantly, Mydei didn’t want to be someone’s alpha. 

He just wanted to be Phainon’s lover, but not his alpha. 

Mydei had to huff at his own thoughts - knitting his brows in minute frustration as he thought it over more and more, “Why do you desire to be privy to such a thing suddenly? Do you not have thoughts of your own to fret over?”

“Hahah..” Phainon laughed softly, a melodious thing that always made Mydei whip his eyes across the room to figure out what the omega was having a laugh over - and now was no less distracting as Mydei keenly watched Phainon; “Your thoughts are way more interesting than mine are right now, Mydei!”

Mydei didn’t reply to that, instead blankly staring at the man he just.. So desperately would push him onto a bed and have his way with Mydei. He just wanted that omega to not be an omega for a night, to fix what was wrong with Mydei’s own secondary gender and free him.

Was that too much to ask for?

“Go on.. What is it?” Phainon pushed as Mydei only sat there staring at him so painfully blankly - mind hollow and empty as he felt those emotions of lust rising in the depths of his body again.

So forceful that he had to swallow them back, not wanting his scent to get stronger around the omega who wore blockers over his own scent. Not wanting to bother him with his thoughts, or his cursed bodily functions.

Instead, Mydei mindlessly closed his eyes before giving a weak grin; “How are we supposed to make this into a competition?”

“Huh? That’s unlike you Mydei.. Usually the competitions are my idea..” Phainon mused, seeming more and more amused before he tilted his head to the side with a laugh, “Are you lying to me and just refusing to say your true thoughts?”

Mydei should have known that Phainon would see through such a feeble attempt to worm out of his grasp, and yet.. Mydei only stared at him as if it would solve his issues. Stared at Phainon as if the omega would stop asking about it.

And he almost was confused when the omega in fact did let up, instead laughing softly yet again; “Don’t worry, either way, I’ll think of a competition!”

“Joy.” Was Mydei’s flat reply as he shook his head, though he really should be excited for it considering Phainon was going along with his lie. Because if he hadn’t.. Mydei would have had to admit what was wrong with him eventually. And there wasn’t much Mydei feared in this life, but discussing his secondary gender with the man he wanted to help him amend it was.. Mortifying to say the least.

Phainon hummed however, once again looking at his teleslate for a few moments as he spoke; “Well.. Regardless, parting hour is soon which means we should just drop the dromas off and then immediately start to make ourselves comfortable in the tavern there.” 

Phainon paused, clearly waiting for Mydei’s reply, to which Mydei had nothing to say over that. Instead huffing a quiet ‘hmph’ as he watched Phainon seemingly scroll through something, whatever that was.. Didn’t concern Mydei however as he idly watched him.

“They’ll meet us inside apparently.” Phainon added on, clearly staring right back at Mydei with a rather blank look on his own face over those words. 

“Oh?”

“Well.. It's hard to miss my white hair and the crown prince I think.” Phainon hummed out, all before leaning back lazily to stare at the sky - more importantly - away from Mydei as he seemed keen on not looking at him while he twirled that pomegranate between his heavy golden gloves skillfully.

But Mydei didn’t mind, even if the omega didn’t see Mydei fit for his attention - he was used to that anyway from the man. He had never been his first pick of alphas, and even when they were alone that didn’t seem any different.

There was, however, just one thing that was bothering him just the tiniest of bits. 

“Mm.” Mydei hummed out, looking at that fruit in his hands. A meaningless thing that probably meant something more if it wasn’t being given to Mydei of all alphas, “What are we even getting for her?”

Mydei asked that and looked back at Phainon - staring at those ethereal blue eyes that seemed to soften over their gazes meeting. Or just because he was amused, and Mydei was more willing to believe the latter at this point in his life. 

“Ah.. Well, that’s a secret!”

A secret.

Mydei could barely keep a straight face as he watched Phainon drag a finger up to his own lips, giving a motion for keeping quiet over his lips all while staring at Mydei. 

Mydei truly doubted that, “Is it?”

“No, but since you asked, I feel like I have to say it is!” Phainon chuckled as he looked away again, moving to peer around the dromas with another noise leaving his throat. One that Mydei couldn’t decipher, and he didn’t think that he cared to. 

“.. Right.” Mydei huffed out as he stared at the back of that man’s head, staring at that stark white hair and his blue fabrics that Aglaea had made for him. A beautiful outfit for a beautiful omega, really.

… But Mydei had no idea how Aglaea expected Phainon to fight and not get titankin blood all over it. Even if he would never doubt nor question her choices anymore.. 

“Look! There’s the town.” Phainon happily told Mydei as he turned just a bit to point at it, and Mydei didn’t even move - instead leaning slightly to peer at it.

It was nothing fancy, but that kind of fit Mydei nowadays. 

Or maybe it just always had, considering his life as a child where a bed simply didn’t exist for him for a long time anyway. 

“Quiant.” Was Mydei’s stoic response, blinking and straightening himself out. No real reason to keep straining to see it when they would be staying there for the night regardless. They would have plenty of time to look around in the morning if they wanted.

… Mydei was debating questioning Aglaea for once, because why on Amphoreus were they assigned to this mission for an entire week when it was just a broker deal?

“But very comfortable looking, isn’t it?” Phainon countered, but that only made Mydei raise a brow, slightly baffled over that being brought up when he had said nothing about such a thing in the first place.

Instead, tilting his head, “I didn’t say it wasn’t.”

“Okay, okay.. I’ll find somewhere to stable the dromas for now.” Phainon chuckled quietly, turning away again to gather the reins in his hands, “Do you want to go and-”

“I’ll be staying at your side for this mission, Deliverer. Did I not make myself clear?” Mydei hissed out, staring at Phainon’s back and he didn’t need to be close to see the way Phainon had stiffened. Plus, the way Phainon had looked over his shoulder was something Mydei felt himself feel flabbergasted over. 

Those blue eyes were so sharp as they stared at Mydei - dark and brewing with a mixture of deeper emotions over those hissed out words. All before snapping to his normal ones and looking forward again with another laugh. 

“Haha.. Sorry, sorry..”

Mydei huffed over that as he tried to swallow down whatever his unsettled feelings were about that expression, looking away as Phainon took the lead in guiding the dromas into a pen. And Mydei wasted no time at gathering his belongings and jumping down. 

Hand still idly holding that pomegranate as he inspected it slowly. If there was one thing he could easily admit defeat over with Phainon; It was the fact Phainon was rather talented in picking out ripe fruits and vegetables.

Something to do with their differences in upbringing, Mydei supposed.

… If he could even call most of his childhood an ‘upbringing’ to begin with, anyway.

Phainon was so very swift to take up his side as well, always seeming clingy towards alphas even if he wasn’t interested in Mydei, even now as he pressed their shoulders together and partly led the way. That ever familiar burning and dazzling grin on his lips as he moved with Mydei, and Mydei thought he was imagining a hand on his back guiding him forward as well, but.. 

“This way this way..” Phainon hummed out as they neared a small and rather run down looking building, not that Mydei minded. He had no issues with poor lodging, he had gone through worse - and arguably this did look comfortable and sweet.. 

“In here?” Mydei asked, all before Phainon seemed to hum beside him. 

“Yep! Nice and shady and ran down, is that fine with you? Like I said you can g-”

“I’m staying.” Mydei growled out once again, feeling his patience threatening to snap over the way this omega seemed so keen on getting rid of him. They usually got along so very well, so why was Phainon desiring to split up so badly?

Usually it was for a competition’s sake, but today.. They hadn’t decided on one yet, instead it was just Phainon wanting Mydei to get lost.

Had he already gotten a whiff of an alpha he was preening to meet?

“Okie dokie! Inside we go there.” Phainon happily chirped as they neared that fire-lit door, only to pause and turn on his heels, just enough to look at Mydei up and down.  All before putting a hand on his hip and one on his chin, as if he were studying the alpha before him.

And Mydei had to hold himself back, trying his best not to allow his eye to twitch over how odd he felt to be given a once over by Phainon of all people..

“Oh wait.. Take your gauntlets off.. No need to show off that much fancy gold when we’re making a deal.” Phainon told him, and that made Mydei stiffen over how he did not really enjoy that idea, but he still.. Moved to take them off - all while feeling those burning eyes staring at him.

Watching him, all before Mydei slowly removed them; “.. And my jewelry?”

That was the question on his mind as he undid the straps of one gauntlet, just to undo the other - staring as he worked to undo them. 

“Err.. No.”

“No?” Mydei asked, cocking his head up to look at the omega who looked.. Almost smug over this for some reason? Like he was enjoying watching Mydei take off his gloves for some reason Mydei couldn’t quite understand.

“It would be like seeing you naked if you took that off.. Keep it on.”

Mydei just blinked over that, “.. You have seen me in the nude before.”

“Anyway, just keep your gauntlets in your lap during this, okay?” Phainon told him with such a cocky smile that Mydei felt even more confused over it - completely lost on whatever the meaning was behind his looks. 

“.. Okay.” 

And for some reason, that only made Phainon look even happier - practically glowing all before he waved his hand dismissively with a chuckle, “Actually.. Keep them on, they fit you.”

Mydei had to tilt his head to the side over that - staring at Phainon before giving a brief chuckle over that, flexing his fingers idly; “Of course they fit me, I had them specifically crafted to fit my hands perfectly.”

All to put those gauntlets back on with a huff, snapping them easily onto his hands again with ease and practiced movements - somewhat annoyed that he had taken them off in the first place. But whatever, he preferred them on anyway.. 

Phainon took a moment all before nodding over Mydei’s stoic explanation, “Right.” 

Mydei barely even got a second to think to himself before Phainon nodded and made way into that small tavern, guiding Mydei once again and something about it felt odd. Out of place - almost like he was being tested over something.

… Was it his lack of control in the situation? His instincts were nipping at him to start bullying this omega, to take charge and force himself to command Phainon instead of listening to him. Yet he just.. Didn’t want to do that as Phainon instead hummed, innocently looking around for a decent spot to sit all while Mydei just watched him.

Staring at that omega as he worked out where to go in his mind seemingly, all before grinning and walking a few steps already, “Come on now.. Let’s sit here, Mydei!”

“In the corner?” Mydei asked, but he was already begrudgingly following anyway. Even if his instincts were still clawing into him, trying so hard to remind him that he is the alpha here, not Phainon. But he.. 

“Well.. It is a shady underhanded deal happening, after all..” Phainon pointed out as he sat down, patting the space on the bench beside him, “C’mon, slide in beside me.”

Mydei was very fond of Phainon..

Mydei huffed as he walked towards that table, all before settling down beside Phainon - sliding in to push their shoulders together. Not because he wanted to, but because there certainly wasn’t enough room. Especially with their belongings they had packed for the week..

“Mydei..” Phainon breathed out, and Mydei had to blink over the seductive tone Phainon’s voice was taking on,  “You’re.. Sitting really close to me..”

Mydei had to ignore whatever emotion was creeping into him as he sniffed at the air, eyes moving to now inspect the establishment as he had time to actually look around. Borderline empty outside of them both.. 

“I don’t have a choice, this seat clearly isn’t built for two people of our size.” Mydei growled out, moving a hand to lay on the table flatly before he shot a sharp look to Phainon, “Would you prefer me to stand?”

“No.. No, it’s.. Too late anyway, stay there.” Phainon conceded immediately, sighing loudly as he seemed to sink more into the chair - and Mydei had almost wished he had said yes to Mydei standing because.. Phainon smelled really good, and Mydei almost thought he could feel that omega leaning into him.. 

His scent was so good that Mydei dragged his golden claws into the wood - rubbing at the patterns of the wood slowly before managing to blink over that sentence, “.. Too late?”

Mydei wasn’t sure if he really was off his concentration tonight, or if Phainon just smelled so good that he was distracted by the omega that was pressed up against him. But it seemed so abrupt when someone new appeared at their table - making his head jerk to the side to stare at him.

An old looking man, feeble and weak, probably nearing Thanatos’s door just by age alone; but that didn’t seem to matter. Not as he beamed such a huge smile over the duo. Such a big smile that made Mydei bite down his own rising hairs on his skin - raising a brow over how he could truly feel by instincts alone that this was a shady man.

Even at his big age..

“It’s not everyday a crown prince comes out to handle a deal!” The man chuckled, all before settling down across from them with such a large bag at his hip. All to give them that familiar dazzling smile to both of them - one that made Mydei rather sure how Phainon got conned a lot on relics and antiques.

This conman didn’t seem to have much of a scent, it was either a beta, or a smart man using scent blockers no matter alpha or omega.. Or just so old that his scent had faded into the depths of time.

“Mm.” Was all Mydei managed over that, already creasing his brows and schooling his face into a level of stoicism. One that didn’t last at all.

How could it when Phainon hooked their arms together - immediately tugging Mydei even closer as he hugged onto Mydei’s right arm, “Well.. We’re just so in love, I couldn’t imagine going so far from Okhema and not bringing my alpha with me!”

.. Love?

Mydei felt himself stiffen over that, barely able to quell the loud screams of his inner alpha in his mind over being called Phainon’s alpha of all things as well. Being called his lover at all, Mydei could barely stop himself from letting out a confused noise over it all, instead.. He was merely stunlocked as he let Phainon hold onto his arm so tightly. 

“Oh?! You’re mates?!”

“Of course! You haven’t heard the rumors of us being lovers before?” Phainon asked with a sweet little laugh that Mydei had only ever heard him use towards other alphas - one that he didn’t think was ever meant for his ears. And now Phainon was rubbing on his arm, moving his head to lay on Mydei’s shoulder. 

“Oh! That makes this so much sweeter!” The man laughed along with Phainon, almost making Mydei’s stomach curdle over how this felt like a cruel joke to his own emotions. He wanted to jerk his arm away, to refuse, but he knew this was some type of plan Phainon had conjured up.

It would never be more than that, just a joke, just a playful thing, just nothing to Phainon - all while Mydei could feel his own reflexes firing up. He could only pray he was keeping himself under enough control to not be scenting the area too heavily with his feelings of being called Phainon’s alpha..

He didn’t even want to be his alpha.. He just wanted to be his lover, and yet.. He was here accepting whatever scraps he was at the mercy of being given. 

“Mhm! I was interested in the love potions you’ve been brewing up! Who is a better fit to pick up and try such a creation than two mates?” Phainon asked, and Mydei had to hold back a growl in his throat as he felt Phainon’s head rub into his shoulder.

A thing he would enjoy, if not for feeling so horribly numb right now - as if he was just being used.. 

“Hahah! But aren’t you two already in love?” The vendor asked, giving a small nervous laugh as he kept looking between them - making Mydei only narrow his eyes deeper. Growing more and more unamused by the fact everyone seemed to be making a mockery of him today. Just his luck, he supposed. 

“Oh.. It was an accidental mating while on my heat, actually..” Phainon said in such a saddened tone that Mydei couldn’t help but growl over that. Bristling slightly over the idea that he lost himself and bit Phainon during a heat in this odd lie he was being pulled into.

… But Mydei was pretty sure he could still feel it as he stretched idly, agreeing to accompany Phainon to give their.. Rather edited recollection of this week’s events. But she didn’t need to know the personal details of their week, anyway. 

All to say he was a fool to think they had won this game, an utter idiot as they both turned away with polite words after their organized recounting had been given.. Two absolute buffoons as Aglaea hummed loudly; 

“Phainon.. Mydeimos, before you go, may I ask why the innkeeper of that small town has already sent me a restraining order on the Chrysos Heirs?” And then a heavy sigh, “Rather nice choker you have, Mydeimos, where did you get it?”
